meta.name: ens-mod
meta.author: Enless
meta.description:
Add new campaign on 3 planets (still WIP:)

The mod is focused on a difficulty slightly higher than the main game and follows the game design principles of the original Mindustry

Currently, the mod contains 6 sectors of the first of three planets. The development is delayed, but it has not been abandoned. I hope to complete the first sector of the second planet by 2027, which is planned to follow the 8 sector of the first planet.



Please rate me on github!
